## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Rage is NOT simulated — `rage_amount` (0-100, default 100) and `berserk_active` (bool, default True) are plain user-set conditions; every Rage generation/drain clause is informational only. 'Bonuses use 2x Max Rage while Berserk is active' is modeled as effective_rage = rage_amount x (2 if berserk_active else 1), applied only to the Attack-Speed-per-Rage line and Artificial Moon's Double Damage chance. PARTIAL COVERAGE: Seething Spirit's own damage (Ritual of Offering's permanent Spirit; Fury's Onslaught's use-triggered Spirit) and Ritual of Offering's player-Disarm zero-out are NOT modeled — they need a new post-offense engine pass (a StatResult.spirit_offense sibling field, mirroring minion_offense) that doesn't exist yet. Everything else in the full node tree (base trait, Artificial Moon, all 6 advanced picks) is modeled — see backend/engine/hero_traits/seething_silhouette.py's status_lines for the exact per-line breakdown, including explicit `warning` rows for the unmodeled Spirit pieces so the app never overclaims full coverage.
